topic: Night and day: how did dinosaurs sleep?
title: How Did Dinosaurs Sleep? | Dino Pals
fact: Many dinosaurs like Maiasaura slept in big cozy groups called colonies to stay safe together.

topic: How do we know about dinosaurs? Fossils explained
title: How Do We Know About Dinosaurs? Fossils Explained | Dino Pals
fact: Fossils are the hard parts of animals, like bones and teeth, that turned into rock over millions of years.

topic: Dinosaur colors: did dinosaurs have feathers?
title: Did Dinosaurs Have Feathers? Dinosaur Colors! | Dino Pals
fact: Many dinosaurs had fluffy feathers instead of scales, just like modern birds!
